assets.usage: Static backdrop behind the scrolling skill tree panel (cover-cropped RawImage).
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept / game UI texture. Generate one original HELLSCRIPT dark gothic action RPG skill-tree background plate, portrait 1024x1536. OPAQUE PNG. A dark weathered stone slab with a faint, low-contrast engraved motif of a great tree trunk with branching limbs and roots etched into the stone. Very subtle antique brass dust in the engraving grooves. Heavy soft vignette toward all edges. Overall very dark olive-black and umber, #161813 and #24271d; the middle is only slightly lighter so bright small skill icons overlaid later stay readable. Painterly, tactile dark gothic rendering consistent with the supplied style references, using their palette only, never copying their content. Muted brass #c8ac77, bronze #625536 used extremely sparingly. This is a background texture filling the whole canvas, not an illustration mounted in a frame. No bright highlights, frames, borders, UI elements, characters, text, letters, numbers, letter-like runes, watermarks or signatures. Do not copy any existing game's art, logo or UI.
